# Multiagent orchestration

CRITICAL VISUAL RULE: communicate only through characters, colored branch paths, checkpoints, and composition. Every screen and panel must be blank. Do not draw the GitHub logo, Octocat/Invertocat silhouette, wordmark, letters, numbers, code, charts, interface controls, badges, or labeled icons.

Create premium animated 16:9 GitHub key art, composed safely inside a 3:2 generation canvas. Render a cinematic 2.5D animated-film still with cel-shaded human characters, GitHub dark-mode depth, contribution-grid texture, luminous branch paths, crisp Octicon-inspired geometry, and generous negative space. Use approximately 80% near-black or off-white, 10% neutral gray, 5% GitHub green, and 5% Copilot purple.

Show one accountable human technical lead coordinating four distinct animated specialist teams in clearly bounded research, implementation, validation, and review lanes. Make each lane visually independent, route evidence through visible commit-like checkpoints, and converge the branch paths at one human-controlled merge. The visual POV is disciplined orchestration: parallel work succeeds because ownership and merge control stay centralized.

Reserve the left 42% for slide copy and place the orchestration scene on the right. No logos, mascots, generic robots, words, letters, fake UI, screenshots, interface panels, or watermarks.
